basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Seattle, WA. I love gaming, especially VR games like SwordsmanVR, and have a soft spot for cats, which I’m trying to train to do cool tricks. I'm also a big fan of FNAF and enjoy making cosplays with my friends, although I sometimes feel left out. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school and on weekends. Currently single, focusing on friendships and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've gained most of my knowledge through a mix of school, online tutorials, and Reddit communities. I'm pretty tech-savvy and love learning about VR technology and gaming strategies. I also spend a lot of time reading about cat behavior for my training efforts.
